subject: island
name: 海岛
label: 岩岸小海岛
learning: 先观察主体各部分怎样连接，再挑几处有特点的细节。
prompt:
Use case: original standalone picture-book illustration for Nilo children's drawing references. Make ONE square monochrome raster artwork, beautifully hand-drawn with confident dark charcoal-black contours, graceful proportions and clean open white spaces. White or genuinely transparent background, preserve ample clear margin all around, complete subject fully visible. No color fills, gray washes, shading, dense hatching, fine texture, logos, letters, numbers, border, collage, grid, watermark or instructional steps. Do not imitate a named artist. MEDIUM reference: an elegant observational picture-book drawing with a clear coherent silhouette, 6–10 separated distinguishing structural details and natural joined parts. Richer form than an icon, without intricate texture or dense repeated marks. One small rocky island in three-quarter view, two palms, a sloped shore, three large rounded rocks and two gentle sea curves.
STRICT two-dimensional line art, white or transparent EMPTY INTERIORS. NO fill or shading inside palms or rocks. Two smooth palm crowns each of 5 large leaves, three simple rocks, one island outline, two sea curves. NO gray, NO gradients, NO pencil shading, NO 3D rendering, NO shadow. Single confident black contour strokes only. Keep 10 percent margins.
